verses.text: These are the words of Jeremiah, Hilkiah’s son. He was one of the priests in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin.
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah.

The LORD kept speaking to him while Josiah’s son Jehoiakim was king of Judah, and through the end of the eleventh year of Josiah’s son Zedekiah, king of Judah, when Jerusalem’s people were taken captive in the fifth month.
Then the LORD spoke to me.
“Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were even born, I set you apart. I picked you to be a prophet to the nations.”
I said, “Oh, Lord GOD! I don’t know how to speak. I’m just a kid!”
But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I’m just a kid.’ You’ll go to whoever I send you to, and you’ll say whatever I tell you to say.
Don’t let them scare you. I’m right here with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
Then the LORD reached out and touched my mouth. He said to me, “Look, I’ve put my words in your mouth.
Today I’m putting you over nations and kingdoms so you can pull up by the roots and tear down, destroy and overthrow, build and plant.”
Then the LORD spoke to me again. “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see an almond branch.”
The LORD said to me, “You saw it right. I’m watching over my word to make it happen.”
The LORD spoke to me a second time. “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling pot, and it’s tipping away from the north.”
Then the LORD said to me, “Disaster is about to spill out of the north onto everyone living in this land.

Look, I’m calling all the families from the northern kingdoms,” says the LORD. “They’ll come, and each will set up his throne at the entrance to Jerusalem’s gates. They’ll come against its walls on every side and against every city in Judah.
I’ll pronounce my judgments for all the evil my people have done. They walked away from me, burned incense to other gods, and bowed down to what their own hands made.
“So tighten your belt, get up, and tell them everything I tell you to say. Don’t lose your nerve in front of them, or I’ll make you lose your nerve right there in front of them.
Look what I’ve made you today: a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls, ready to stand against the whole land—Judah’s kings, its princes, its priests, and its people.
They’ll fight you, but they won’t beat you. I’m with you,” says the LORD, “and I’ll rescue you.”
